raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

On CI now C++ unit tests run as one test case in serial. This is faster than running in parallel but if it fails we can't tell what's broken from the CI logs. This PR makes it easier to debug by dumping the log if it fails and also adds an env var so when you debug you can make run in parallel and use filters to run certain cases

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

Please list the changes introduced in this PR:

- Dump the log if C++ UT fails
- Add an env var to run C++ UT in parallel, which allows you to use filters to select cases you want to run

files.patch:
@@ -20,4 +20,4 @@ cd $TE_PATH/tests/cpp
 cmake -GNinja -Bbuild .
 cmake --build build
 export OMP_NUM_THREADS=$((NUM_PHYSICAL_CORES / NUM_PARALLEL_JOBS))
-ctest --test-dir build -j$NUM_PARALLEL_JOBS --output-junit $XML_LOG_DIR/ctest_cppunittest.xml
+ctest --test-dir build -j$NUM_PARALLEL_JOBS --output-on-failure --output-junit $XML_LOG_DIR/ctest_cppunittest.xml

@@ -32,4 +32,4 @@ cd $TE_PATH/tests/cpp
 cmake -GNinja -Bbuild .
 cmake --build build
 export OMP_NUM_THREADS=$((NUM_PHYSICAL_CORES / NUM_PARALLEL_JOBS))
-ctest --test-dir build -j$NUM_PARALLEL_JOBS --output-junit $XML_LOG_DIR/ctest_cppunittest.xml
+ctest --test-dir build -j$NUM_PARALLEL_JOBS --output-on-failure --output-junit $XML_LOG_DIR/ctest_cppunittest.xml

@@ -58,4 +58,11 @@ target_compile_options(test_operator PRIVATE -O2 -fopenmp)
 # Keep all operator tests in one process so CUDA initialization and, when enabled,
 # the embedded Python interpreter and CuTeDSL kernel cache are initialized only once.
 # TODO(kainingz): This will only use 1 CPU and 1 GPU. Make it able to utilize all CPUs and GPUs later
-add_test(NAME test_operator COMMAND test_operator)
+# For debugging, configure with NVTE_TEST_DEBUG_CPP_UT_IN_PARALLEL=1 to register each GoogleTest case as
+# its own ctest test, so failures are reported per case and can be selected with `ctest -R`.
+if("$ENV{NVTE_TEST_DEBUG_CPP_UT_IN_PARALLEL}" STREQUAL "1")
+  include(GoogleTest)
+  gtest_discover_tests(test_operator DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT 600 DISCOVERY_MODE PRE_TEST)
+else()
+  add_test(NAME test_operator COMMAND test_operator)
+endif()
